findings.issue: Error strings built at a pointer copied from mem[64] are not read back past the later 'mem[mem[64]]' stores, so 45 reverts never show their reason ('40', '60'-'65', '4', '44', '83'-'85', '90', '93', '94'), while the same functions show 'revert with '1'' when the offset is constant. Two different reasons are merged into one raw revert after a join (setPowerStrategy '41'/'63', activateVoting '4'/'8'), the fee transfer's empty calldata is 'mem[mem[64] len _34 - mem[64] + mem[_34] + 32]' and the event amounts are raw memory.
findings.rule: Treat a variable assigned mem[64] as equal to mem[64] until the next store to slot 64; with the free pointer bumped past it, a later store at mem[64] cannot alias the string, so forward it and decode the revert, call and log data.
